scope: Classical force-informed vMF angular proposal, with exact forward/reverse S2 densities, after uniform angular control failed.
hypothesis: Uniform angular proposals accepted0/256 and5/256. Use the projected physical tangent force to direct angular moves before attributing this to missing AI capacity.
rotation: Uniform terminal choice, uniform concentration label, then vMF on S2 with eta=c*u+0.5*clipped_surface_score. Surface score uses radius times COM-projected physical force/kT. Recompute the same-label reverse vMF parameter at y; include both normalizers. Radius and passive coordinates are retained, so the r^2 angular measure factor cancels.
exchange: Uniform terminal exchange with its existing graph eligibility, explicit inverse and COM volume; no learned selector.
unused_scale_draws: A scale label is drawn at every microstep for deterministic replay; it affects local steps only and is unused on rotation/exchange steps.
stop_rule: Complete two bounded arms and replay every vMF density, draw, projected force and MH ratio. Conditional S2 density is not a full Cartesian endpoint density or an AI novelty claim.
